periods.time: Ikki's collapse before final duel and Nango's commentary
periods.label: 大英雄的遗言
titles: 黑铁家先祖/传奇魔法骑士

status.current: deceased; remembered as Ikki's spiritual starting point

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Gave Ikki the words that let him believe in himself despite talentlessness.
relationships.torajiro-nango: Old wartime comrade and lifelong rival.

periods.summary: Ryoma appears through Ikki's memory as the person whose words became Ikki's origin: if he is weak, he should work harder than anyone and believe in himself. During the final match Nango remarks that Ikki resembles Ryoma, linking Ikki's will to the old hero's legacy.

key_events.summary: Ikki recalls Ryoma's words while resisting collapse.
Nango compares Ikki to Ryoma after his victory.
